title: WPMS/2694/2017 of Sukhdev Singh Vs Life Insurance Corporation Of India AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 2694 of 2017 (M/S)
Sukhdev Singh ......Petitioner
Versus
Lift Insurance Corporation of India and others
...... Respondents.
Present:
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Alok Mahra, Advocate for the respondents.
Dated: 31
st October, 2017
JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
The petitioner has questioned the validity of the order
dated 21st August, 2017, passed by the Vth Additional
District Judge, Dehradun in P.P. Appeal No. 43 of 1995,
Sardar Dharam Singh Vs. Life Insurance Corporation of
India and another, whereby, the learned Appellate Court,
while considering the delay condonation application filed in
support of the substitution application, preferred by the
petitioner seeking to substitute the heirs of late Sardar
Dharam Singh, has been rejected.
The ground taken in the delay condonation
application filed in substitution application, as preferred by
the petitioner before the Court below, was that on the death
of Sardar Dharam Singh, they have handed over the records
for doing the needful for filing substitution application to
the counsel but on account of the counsel's mistake, the
substitution application could not be filed within time and
there chanced a delay of 6 months and 7 days. The delay
condonation application was filed by the petitioner

2
alongwith the substitution application has been rejected and
consequently, the substitution application too stood
dismissed.
At this stage, this Court feels that the reason which
has been assigned by the petitioner in the delay
condonation application in its para 5, is to the effect which
assigns, the reason for delay being attributed to the counsel
who derelicted in filing the substitution application on
account of the reason known to him.
It is an established preposition that the litigant to the
proceedings should not suffer on account of the mistake of
the counsel, as such, this Court feels that instead of
adopting the hyper technical view for the purposes of
consideration of the delay condonation application, the
learned Court below ought to have taken a pragmatic
approach while considering the application under Section 5
filed in support of the substitution application.
In response to it, the learned counsel for the
respondents submits that he has doubts with regard to the
propriety of the will on the basis of which, the petitioner
claims himself to be substituted, as it would be finding
reference in the substitution application itself.
This Court is not expressing any opinion with regard
to the merits of the substitution application which is yet to
be decided after providing an opportunity to the parties by
the Appellate Court. However, this Court is not in
agreement with the reasons assigned by the Appellate Court
while rejecting Section 5 application and, thus, the
impugned order so far it relates to the rejection of Section 5

3
application filed in support of substitution application is
quashed.
The delay in filing substitution application is hereby
condoned. The Appellate Court is requested to decide the
substitution application on its own merits after providing
due opportunity to the parties without being influenced by
any observation made above.
It is also hoped and trusted that since the matter is
pending for a considerable long time, the Appellate Court,
after deciding the substitution application, the proceedings
of the P.P. Appeal No. 43 of 1995 would also be expedited
and be decided without any observation.
The writ petition stands disposed of accordingly.
No order as to costs.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
31.10.2017
Shiv
